notes: Parts are unchanged from step 1; step 1 was correct.
Circuit per the text: MIDI pin 5 -> 220 ohm (r1) -> Uno digital pin 1 (TX); MIDI pin 4 -> 220 ohm (r2) -> 5V; MIDI pin 2 -> GND.
Breadboard holes are my reading of the image, using the catalogue naming (top bank rows a-e, bottom bank rows f-j). The image labels the rows the other way up, but the nets are the same.

The jack's pins 5, 2 and 4 sit in columns 7, 8 and 9 of the top bank. Each resistor bridges the centre gap from the top bank to the bottom bank in its column. The yellow wire (7b.h) and red wire (9b.h) take the bottom-bank ends to Uno pin 1 and 5V.
The black wire's breadboard end is in column 8 (8t.c), the same strip as jack pin 2. The other end goes to the Uno GND header pin next to AREF (GND.1).
MIDI jack pins 1 and 3 are unused and have no connections.
